replace=config

start=ChorrolNorthernGoodsAndTrade::ref=0x0280fa::side=south
skip-menu=1

camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local NPC=require('openmw.types').NPC
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(self.cell.name=='ChorrolNorthernGoodsAndTrade','Player left original shop')
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at turn-in')
 local darma=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x280fa))
 assert(darma and darma:isValid() and not Actor.isDead(darma) and darma.cell.name==self.cell.name,'Living Dar-Ma missing from home')
 local level=NPC.stats.level(self)
 print(string.format('ReturnReward skill=%.0f fame=%.0f major=%d personality=%d stealth=%d xp=%.5f',NPC.stats.skills.mercantile(self).base,NPC.stats.reputation(self).current,level.progress,level.skillIncreasesForAttribute.personality,level.skillIncreasesForSpecialization.stealth,NPC.stats.skills.mercantile(self).progress))
 if core.isWorldPaused() then print('ReturnReward paused');return end
 local mother=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x234fd));assert(mother and mother:isValid(),'Original mother missing')
 local target=mother.position+util.vector3(0,0,85)
 local v=target-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 local c=target-camera.getPosition();local pitch=-math.atan2(c.z,math.sqrt(c.x*c.x+c.y*c.y))
 if math.abs(angle)<0.035 and math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<0.03 then print('ReturnReward ready=mother') end
 print(string.format('ReturnReward aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*256+.5)))))
end}}}}
